result.instructions: Tools for AWeber, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which lists do I have in AWeber, and how many subscribers does each one hold?"; "Is jane@example.com subscribed to my newsletter list?"; "Show me my last three sent broadcasts and their subjects.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes AWeber data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run aweber_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run aweber_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run aweber_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. aweber_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: aweber_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts
tools.description: List the AWeber accounts this connection can access, with their ids. Start here to find an accountId. AWeber API: GET /accounts.

tools.name: aweber_get_account
tools.title: Get an account
tools.description: Get one AWeber account: its name, company and sign-up details. AWeber API: GET /accounts/{accountId}.

accountId.description: AWeber account id (from aweber_list_accounts). Omit to use the connected account.

tools.name: aweber_list_lists
tools.title: List lists
tools.description: List the subscriber lists in an AWeber account, with their subscriber counts. Use the list ids in the other tools. AWeber API: GET /accounts/{accountId}/lists.

accountId.description: AWeber account id (from aweber_list_accounts). Omit to use the connected account.

tools.name: aweber_get_list
tools.title: Get a list
tools.description: Get one subscriber list: its name, total, unsubscribed and unconfirmed counts, and creation date. AWeber API: GET /accounts/{accountId}/lists/{listId}.

accountId.description: AWeber account id (from aweber_list_accounts). Omit to use the connected account.

tools.name: aweber_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: List the custom fields defined on one list. Their names are the keys for custom_fields in the subscriber tools. AWeber API: GET /accounts/{accountId}/lists/{listId}/custom_fields.

accountId.description: AWeber account id (from aweber_list_accounts). Omit to use the connected account.

tools.name: aweber_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the tags used on one list. AWeber API: GET /accounts/{accountId}/lists/{listId}/tags.

accountId.description: AWeber account id (from aweber_list_accounts). Omit to use the connected account.

tools.name: aweber_find_subscribers
tools.title: Find subscribers
tools.description: Find subscribers on one list by exact email, status, or subscribe date range. Matches are exact, not partial. AWeber API: GET /accounts/{accountId}/lists/{listId}/subscribers?ws.op=find.

accountId.description: AWeber account id (from aweber_list_accounts). Omit to use the connected account.

subscribed_after.description: Subscribed on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

subscribed_before.description: Subscribed on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: aweber_get_subscriber
tools.title: Get a subscriber
tools.description: Get one subscriber by id: status, subscribe and unsubscribe dates, tags and custom field values. AWeber API: GET /accounts/{accountId}/lists/{listId}/subscribers/{subscriberId}.

accountId.description: AWeber account id (from aweber_list_accounts). Omit to use the connected account.

tools.name: aweber_list_broadcasts
tools.title: List broadcasts
tools.description: List broadcasts on one list by status: draft (API-created drafts only), scheduled, or sent. Read only: nothing is sent. AWeber API: GET /accounts/{accountId}/lists/{listId}/broadcasts.

accountId.description: AWeber account id (from aweber_list_accounts). Omit to use the connected account.

tools.name: aweber_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List the follow-up ('f') and broadcast ('b') campaigns on one list, follow-ups first. Read only. AWeber API: GET /accounts/{accountId}/lists/{listId}/campaigns.

accountId.description: AWeber account id (from aweber_list_accounts). Omit to use the connected account.

tools.name: aweber_add_subscriber
tools.title: Add a subscriber
tools.description: Add ONE subscriber to a list. Only add an address whose owner asked to join this list; AWeber forbids bought, shared or scraped lists. An existing address returns HTTP 400 unless update_existing is true. AWeber API: POST /accounts/{accountId}/lists/{listId}/subscribers.

accountId.description: AWeber account id (from aweber_list_accounts). Omit to use the connected account.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the field name (names must exist on the list; see aweber_list_custom_fields).

tags.description: Tags to add to the subscriber.

misc_notes.description: Free-text notes stored on the subscriber.

update_existing.description: If true, update the subscriber when the address already exists. Tags are appended. If custom_fields is sent, every custom field not in this request is cleared: send all fields to keep.

tools.name: aweber_update_subscriber
tools.title: Update a subscriber
tools.description: Update ONE subscriber on a list, found by email: name, status (subscribed or unsubscribed), misc notes, tags to add or remove, or custom fields. Setting status to unsubscribed removes the address from sends. If custom_fields is sent, include every field that must keep its value. AWeber API: PATCH /accounts/{accountId}/lists/{listId}/subscribers?subscriber_email=.

accountId.description: AWeber account id (from aweber_list_accounts). Omit to use the connected account.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the field name (names must exist on the list; see aweber_list_custom_fields).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with AWeber
prompts.description: What you can do with AWeber here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: map_accounts_lists_and_custom_fields
prompts.title: Map accounts, lists and custom fields
prompts.description: List the accounts this connection can reach, then the lists of one account with their subscriber counts. Read the custom fields and tags of a list.

prompts.name: check_whether_an_address_is_subscribed
prompts.title: Check whether an address is subscribed
prompts.description: Find a subscriber on a list by exact email, status or subscribe date. Open the subscriber to read its status, dates and tags.

prompts.name: review_broadcasts_and_follow_up_campaigns
prompts.title: Review broadcasts and follow-up campaigns
prompts.description: List the broadcasts of a list by status: draft, scheduled or sent. List the follow-up and broadcast campaigns too. These reads send nothing.

prompts.name: add_one_subscriber_who_asked_to_join
prompts.title: Add one subscriber who asked to join
prompts.description: Add one address to a list. Add only a person who asked to join that list, because AWeber forbids bought, shared or scraped lists.

prompts.name: tag_edit_or_unsubscribe_one_subscriber
prompts.title: Tag, edit or unsubscribe one subscriber
prompts.description: Update one subscriber, found by email. Change the name or notes, add or remove tags, set custom fields, or set the status to unsubscribed.
